title: Ember Orchard: The Navigator's Seed Archive
premise: In a volcanic garden whose fruit germinates in cooling ash, the navigator must synchronize the return route to the signal using a star-and-current sextant.
ending: Recover the Seed Archive and return with the verified return bearing; Orchard Keepers can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive thermal surge while evading the ashwood guardian without sacrificing the verified return bearing.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Orchard Keepers to witness the star-and-current sextant.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to accept an unverified coordinate
